tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Page ground. Plain white; every screen sits on it (R3 순백).

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Cool off-white band (v2.0, was warm #f7f4ef): sheet/modal header, category tiles, image placeholder tiles. Never the page ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards that earn a card (TypeCard, VerdictCard, BundleCard, VetCard) — white on white, so the 1px `line` border is what makes a card.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and row dividers (R3). Borders, never shadows.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, selected-card border, focus base (cool, v2.0).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, spec numbers, primary text on bg-000 / bg-100 / surface. 16.3:1 on white.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Running body text and section subtitles (R3, new in v2.0). 7.5:1 on white. Headings and numbers stay `ink`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta, captions, review dates, subtext, and the ○ 나중에 word. 5.5:1 on white, 5.1:1 on bg-100.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Teal (R3). The one CTA fill (text `on-brand`), selected states, progress fill, focus, large spec accent numbers. As small text only on bg-000/surface (4.8:1); on tints use `brand-text`.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the selected TypeCard, pressed toggles and the hub summary progress track.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Links and brand-colored small text on bg-000 / bg-100 / brand-soft. 5.8:1 on white, 5.1:1 on brand-soft.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills (v2.0: white on teal). 4.8:1 on brand.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Secondary warmth: mascot fur, empty-state illustration, bundle tier chip. Never a control.

tokens.name: peach-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind a mascot in the hub header.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Highlight: completion celebration, the parrot mascots' yellow. Never text.

tokens.name: status-ready
tokens.usage: ✓ 준비완료 icon and text. 5.3:1 on bg-000, 4.6:1 on its soft ground. Meaning color; not the brand.

tokens.name: status-ready-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the ✓ verdict line and ready chips.

tokens.name: status-first
tokens.usage: ! 먼저 준비 (a REQUIRED item still open). 5.6:1 on bg-000, 4.7:1 on its soft ground. Differs from status-fail by lightness and icon.

tokens.name: status-first-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind the hub 'N개 미완료' count.

tokens.name: status-check
tokens.usage: △ 확인 필요 and 권장 미달. 5.5:1 on bg-000, 4.9:1 on its soft ground.

tokens.name: status-check-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the △ verdict line.

tokens.name: status-later
tokens.usage: ○ 나중에 and NOT_NOW rows. Same value as ink-muted (v2.0: ≥4.5:1, 5.5:1 on white); icon + word still carry it.

tokens.name: status-fail
tokens.usage: ✕ 최소 미달. 7.2:1 on bg-000, 5.8:1 on its soft ground. Darker than status-first so the two never read alike.

tokens.name: status-fail-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the ✕ verdict line.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring on every surface. 4.8:1 on white (3:1+ everywhere).

tokens.name: mascot-ink
tokens.usage: Mascot eyes and nose (they sit on fur, not on the ground).

families.sans: "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, "WS Fallback Noto", "WS Fallback Malgun", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Noto Sans KR", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hub animal name beside the mascot. Never below 28px.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Section headers: 먼저 준비 / 권장 / 선택 / 지금은 필요 없어요.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 밤에 수 km를 달리는 습성이 있어 쳇바퀴가 필요해요.

styles.name: cta
styles.usage: Buttons. One brand-filled CTA per screen; the rest are outlined.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Review dates, source counts, chip text. ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase-style small labels above a value (Korean: no case change, keep tracking).

styles.name: spec
styles.usage: The number is the strongest element in its sentence: tabular-nums, ink, never muted.

styles.name: spec-lg
styles.usage: VerdictCard headline value and the cage context readout.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside rows between label and meta.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding; input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a page title; around the hub mascot.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state breathing room; home hero.

tokens.name: num-unit-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between a large spec number and its unit run (「28」 8px 「cm 이상」), same baseline. New in v2.0.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, verdict lines.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, TypeCard, BundleCard.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, the hub summary block, VerdictCard.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Progress track, status chips, mascot ground disc.

tokens.name: radius-photo
tokens.usage: Photo / image tile corners ≥768 (R3). New in v2.0.

tokens.name: radius-photo-mobile
tokens.usage: Photo / image tile corners ≤767 (R3). New in v2.0.

shadow.note: No decorative shadows. Only the bottom sheet (mobile), the sticky action bar (mobile) and the desktop detail panel edge lift.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet and sticky action bar on mobile only.

layout.note: Breakpoints and content widths. Mobile-first. Every width keeps the same top-to-bottom page rhythm and the same section order; wider tiers only show more cards per rail and turn bottom sheets into modals/drawers. There is no side navigation at any width.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: ≥768: header shows the text menu, bottom tab bar disappears; sheets become center modals at 600px; rails show 2.5–3 cards.

tokens.name: bp-desktop
tokens.usage: ≥1024: bottom tab bar is replaced by the text menu in the global header; bottom sheets become center modals (`modal-w`); supply/product detail opens as a right drawer (`drawer-w`).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Container: max width of the centered page column at desktop (v2.0: 1200, was 1120). At 1280 the outer margin is 40. Rails and sections never exceed it.

tokens.name: col-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between the list and the map on the vet page (≥1024) — the only side-by-side pair in the product.

tokens.name: grid-gutter
tokens.usage: Gutter of the 12-column desktop grid inside the 1200 container (column 78). New in v2.0.

tokens.name: section-gap
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between home sections ≥768 (R3). New in v2.0.

tokens.name: section-gap-mobile
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between home sections ≤767 (R3). New in v2.0.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Side gutter ≤767.

tokens.name: gutter-wide
tokens.usage: Side gutter ≥768.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Global header height at every width. 1px `line` bottom border, no shadow.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom tab bar (홈 · 용품 · 병원), ≤767 only.

tokens.name: modal-w
tokens.usage: Center modal width ≥1024 (600px at 768–1023). v2.0: every PC layer (L1~L8, including L4/L7) is a 720 modal.

tokens.name: drawer-w
tokens.usage: DEPRECATED (v2.0, R3): the right drawer is retired — PC layers unify on `modal-w` 720. Kept only until step 2 (components) removes its last reference; do not use in new code.

tokens.name: layer-pad
tokens.usage: Inner padding of a PC layer modal (720 → content 640). New in v2.0.

tokens.name: layer-pad-mobile
tokens.usage: Inner padding of a mobile layer sheet (360 → content 328). New in v2.0.

tokens.name: btn-h
tokens.usage: Primary button height at every width. New in v2.0.

tokens.name: input-h
tokens.usage: Numeric input field height (spec checker) at every width. New in v2.0.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Checklist row height ≥768. New in v2.0.

tokens.name: row-h-mobile
tokens.usage: Checklist row height ≤767. New in v2.0.

tokens.name: rail-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a horizontal rail.

tokens.name: rail-peek
tokens.usage: Fraction of the next card visible at the right edge of a mobile rail, so the rail reads as scrollable.

tokens.name: product-card-w
tokens.usage: ProductCard width ≤767. 176px ≥1024. Never wider than a BundleCard — the visual ratio is mascot > bundle > supply > product.

changelog.note: R3 시안(순백+청록) 1단계 토큰. 색 값 교체(ink·brand·line·bg-100·on-brand·focus), ink-body 신설, 상태색 ≥4.5:1 보정(first·check 짙게, later=ink-muted), 레이아웃 신규(grid-gutter·section-gap·layer-pad·btn-h·input-h·row-h·radius-photo·num-unit-gap), content-max 1200, drawer-w 폐기 예정. 폰트 Pretendard 유지.
세이지 민트 v1.2 (디자인 시스템 v1.2 · 캔버스 v14).
